title: Look up a member's savings balance
description: Signs on to the Meridian Core Servicing Console, searches the Member Search panel by Member ID, and reads the member's Savings account current balance from the Member Detail screen. Returns savingsBalance (money), memberName (PII) and memberStatus. Read-only: no records are created, modified or submitted.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Servicing console operator user ID. Injected by the runtime credential store.

inputs.name: operatorPassword
inputs.description: Servicing console operator password. Injected by the runtime credential store.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: The credit union member number to look up (6 digits).

outputs.name: savingsBalance
outputs.description: Current balance of the member's Savings account from the Accounts table

outputs.name: memberName
outputs.description: Full name of the member on the Member Profile panel

target.description: cell "Dolores Ashcroft" in the Member Profile panel

outputs.name: memberStatus
outputs.description: Membership status shown on the Member Profile panel (e.g. Active)

target.description: cell "Active" in the Member Profile panel

steps.intent: Enter the operator ID in the Operator Sign-On panel

target.description: textbox labelled "User ID" in the Operator Sign-On panel

steps.intent: Enter the operator password in the Operator Sign-On panel

target.description: textbox labelled "Password" in the Operator Sign-On panel

steps.intent: Submit the operator sign-on form to access the servicing console

target.description: button "Sign On" in the Operator Sign-On panel

steps.intent: Type the member number into the Member ID field of the Member Search panel

target.description: textbox labelled "Member ID" in the Member Search panel

steps.intent: Run the member search for the entered member ID

target.description: button "Search" in the Member Search panel

checkpoint.description: The Member Detail screen is displayed for the requested member, with an Accounts table containing a Savings row showing a Current Balance.

outcomes.description: No member exists with the supplied member ID, so the search returns no member detail.

probe.rationale: A member ID far outside the demo data range should return no matching record.

evidence.note: Replaying with memberId="999999" ended in failure CHECKPOINT_FAILED, and no declared condition matched the screen it ended on. The wording in (page contains "No member found") is probably not what this application shows. Screen read: "SERVICING Member Search Account Inquiry Transaction History ADMINISTRATION Sign Off Northpoint FCU · Meridian Core 1.4.2 Inquiry Result No member record found for ID 999999. Verify the member number and re-submit. If the member was recently enrolled, allow one business day for host replication. Meri"

outcomes.description: The supplied member ID is not in a valid format and the search panel rejects it before querying.

probe.rationale: Non-numeric input should trigger a field validation message rather than a search.

evidence.note: memberId="ABC" is rejected by this capability's own input contract (Parameter "memberId" does not match required pattern ^\d{6}$), so the application never saw it. INVALID_MEMBER_ID is unreachable through this capability: either the outcome does not belong here, or the parameter is over-constrained.

outcomes.description: The member record exists but the signed-on operator is not entitled to view its account balances.

when.text: Not authorized to view this member

probe.rationale: Adjacent member records in the demo set may carry a restricted-access flag.

evidence.note: Replaying with memberId="100002" ended in failure CHECKPOINT_FAILED, and no declared condition matched the screen it ended on. The wording in (page contains "Not authorized to view this member") is probably not what this application shows. Screen read: "SERVICING Member Search Account Inquiry Transaction History ADMINISTRATION Sign Off Northpoint FCU · Meridian Core 1.4.2 Authorisation Required Entitlement check failed for member 100002. Your operator profile is not entitled to view this record. Contact a branch supervisor to request a temporary en"

recovery.description: A native dialog is blocking the page. Acknowledging it is required before any further step can run. Review whether acknowledging is safe for this flow before approving.
